summary: Joe English Hill in New Boston: listed as once having a fire tower, now gone; no source describes tower remains; nearby pond is on Air Force station grounds.

facts.status_note: Tower gone, per the Forest Fire Lookout Association list.

visit.trail_note: A 2020 hiking report says the trail starts up a private driveway.

events.note: Air Force station transferred to the United States Space Force and renamed the New Boston Space Force Station.

notes_for_editor: No readable source dates the tower or says who built it, so the story has no built or staffing section. Verify before publishing any access claim: AllTrails (403 here) reportedly says the trail is closed indefinitely as of March 2026 because of the base; not verified and not cited. If true, the today section must change. Heights differ: 1,285 ft (NH Family Hikes), 1,240 ft (hiking list), about 1,200 ft (historical society); the story gives no height. A YouTube video reportedly says a fire tower used to be on top (not readable). The historical society page includes a 1951 Navy account that mentions reporting bomb results to a fire tower at the range; it does not say which tower, so it is not used.
